label: Counting characters with a dictionary (uses input)
code:
message = input('Message: ')
count = {}                                  # character -> how many times it was seen
for character in message:
    count.setdefault(character, 0)          # make sure the key exists, starting at 0
    count[character] = count[character] + 1
print(count)
print('Most common:', max(count, key=count.get))
